prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: transparent game boss sprite, full body, single isolated majestic celestial boss called 'Creator of Truth'.
Primary request: an awe-inspiring floating constellation entity formed entirely from many brilliant stars fused together, for a Korean children's fantasy space RPG. One great luminous five-pointed star core, surrounded by sculptural tiers of smaller pointed crystal stars forming a grand symmetrical crown and sweeping wing-like constellations, with elegant thin orbital filaments and tiny suspended starlights. It must read as a coherent powerful boss with a recognizable star silhouette, not a humanoid, not a pile of disconnected icons. Gentle but imposing, no horror, no weapons.
Style/medium: beautifully painted detailed 2D isometric fantasy RPG sprite, classic TalesWeaver and Trickster storybook aesthetic, cream and gold engraved star edges, radiant ivory crystal and restrained lavender/teal highlights, dimensional hand-painted shading, delicate celestial ornamentation. Soft warm brilliance without overwhelming white bloom so contours stay legible.
Composition: centered, entire silhouette within frame, mild three-quarter frontal view, clear upright shape, slightly wider upper constellation wings with a tapered star cluster base. Approximately square canvas, generous 12% transparent padding, no cut edges. Star core is largest at center; intricate subordinate stars emphasize majestic scale. Designed to float above a dark grey game map.
Constraints: actual transparent background, no floor, no pedestal, no sky, no scenery, no text, no numbers, no UI or health bar, no watermark. One boss only, not a sprite sheet.
